title: Legend 2
identity: Doïna Rotaru's *Legend II* is cataloged in the IMEP library as a four-page printed work for oboe or soprano saxophone, published by Henry Lemoine. Rotaru's composer catalog lists *Legend II* as an oboe solo work, so the saxophone option is an alternate instrumental edition rather than proof of an original saxophone commission. No score or matching saxophone recording was inspected.

evidence.claim: IMEP institutional catalog record identifies the printed edition as *Legend II: pour hautbois ou saxophone soprano*, Paris: Henry Lemoine, four pages.
evidence.source_name: Institut royal supérieur de musique et de pédagogie (IMEP) library

evidence.claim: Romanian composers' catalog lists *Legend II* (1996) for solo oboe, published by Henry Lemoine.
CiNii bibliographic record independently lists *Legend II* for soprano saxophone or oboe, Lemoine, c.1998.

collection_flag: Alternate saxophone edition of a work also cataloged for solo oboe; this is a transcription/alternate-instrument concern, not an automatic exclusion.
gaps: No score pages or saxophone performance inspected; technical demands and intended saxophone audience remain unknown.
Publication date differs between undated IMEP record and c.1998 CiNii record.
